items.t: Vistra Is Still Down 17% This Year: Did Earnings Just Mark the Bottom?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysVistra is down 17% in 2026 because Texas power prices stayed weak and Texas elected a governor who wants to pause new data centers. Constellation Energy has fallen even further this year, so part of the drop is a selloff across AI-power stocks, but Texas is Vistra’s own problem.
